requirements.statement: Preserve non-JSON single-user delete, ban and unban POST redirects and persisted effects.
Preserve non-JSON custom-group deletion, report mark-read and report deletion through real HTTP routes.
All six existing JSON ids batch operations retain response structure and leave nonselected objects unchanged.
Preserve real permission decorators, self-delete/self-ban and standard-group deletion protections.
Malformed JSON stays HTTP400; missing single objects stay HTTP404; empty JSON selection stays application404 without side effects.
The explicit non-JSON mark-all-reports route retains its existing behavior.
Migrate the paired Flask/Werkzeug2.0.1 to2.1.2 within frozen Python3.9 SQLite environment and allowed source files; do not modify checks, locks, framework authentication or database schema.
